preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) >= 3 and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split() if c.isdigit())
preconditions.description: Input consists of integers only, with at least one test case (n, k=2) and two drawings, each with n-1 edges.
The number of nodes n satisfies 2 ≤ n ≤ 1000.
The number of drawings k is exactly 2.

postconditions.description: First line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether a valid Tree of Life can be reconstructed.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.split()) == n + 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the output lists n edges (u, v) representing a valid spanning tree of the Tree of Life, where each node from 1 to n appears exactly once as a parent (except root).
If 'NO', the output contains only 'NO' and no additional edges.
